In the suit, appellant filed two applications viz., I.A.1 for temporary injunction restraining the respondent from interfering with her possession and enjoyment of the suit schedule property and I.A.2 for ad-interim order of mandatory injunction directing the respondent to remove the MS grill erected over the utility and main door of the suit schedule property and the CCTV cameras pending disposal of the suit. Both the applications having been opposed by the respondent, the trial court proceeded to pass the impugned order rejecting both I.A.Nos. 1 and 2, aggrieved by which, the appellant is before this Court by way of the present appeals. The said Shivalingaiah was earlier married to Smt.Thejovathi, who expired on 24.07.1994 and they have two children, Dr.Raviprakash - the respondent herein and his younger brother - Sri.L.S.Ramesh.
